description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This confidential role offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success within a supportive environment. We are seeking a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of quality and compliance.The ideal candidate will oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring efficient operations, financial stability, and an outstanding resident experience. This position is critical to maintaining our reputation for excellence and fostering a positive work culture. We offer a competitive salary package for this pivotal leadership role.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility leadership role
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, finances, and staff effectively
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.
